items.text: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel wacho:
Pak mar Moab ok nobedi kendo;
ji nochan kethruokne ei Heshbon kagiwacho kama:
un bende ligangla nolawu mulingʼ thii.
ywak mar duwruok maduongʼ gi kethruok.
Giidho ka giluwo yo madhi Luhith,
kendo ywak malit mar kethruok winjore.
Nikech ugeno kuom timbeu kod mwandu mau,
kanyakla gi jodolo mage kod jotelo mage.
Jaketh gik moko nobi e dala
ka dala kendo onge dala ma notony.
Holo noum kendo got mar mesa nomuki,
"Okwongʼ ngʼat mayom yom e tich Jehova Nyasaye!
Okwongʼ ngʼat ma okano liganglane ma ok ochwerogo remo!
ka divai mowe mos e aguche,
ma ok ool koa ei agulu achiel
kiloko machielo kendo pod ok odhi e twech.
"Kinde biro, ma anaor ji manopuke oko,
giniwe agulni mage nono kendo toyo agulni mage.
Eka Moab wiye nokuodi gi Kemosh,
mana kaka od Israel wiye nokuot,
Ruoth, ma nyinge Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho niya,
yawuote mabeyo noter e kar nek.
Ywageuru, un jogo duto modak machiegni kode,
wachuru ni, 'Mano kaka otur odunga mar loch maratego,
kendo otiek miechu madongo mochiel motegno gohinga.
Chunguru e bath yo kendo ungʼi,
Land e Arnon ni Moab okethi.
e got mar mesa kuom Holon,
Bozra, kuom mier duto mag Moab,
man mabor kod mago man machiegni.
ma itengʼone wiyi gi achaya sa moro
Chaluru ka akuch odugla maloso ode e dho rogo.
kendo ngʼayi mage ok nyal gimoro.
negichopo nyaka e nam mar Jazer.
Jaketh gik moko osepodho e olembegi
Ilo gi mor orumo e puoth olembe
onge ngʼama nyonogi gi koko mar ilo.
koa Heshbon nyaka Eleale gi Jahaz,
koa Zoar nyaka chop Horonaim gi Eglath Shelishiya,
nimar kata pige mag Nimrim bende osetwo.
E Moab anatiek jogo matimo misengini
kendo ma wangʼo ubani ne nyisechegi,"
oywagore ka asili ne jo-Kir Hareseth.
kendo yie tik ka yie tik ongʼad oko;
oko kendo nungo ka nungo oum gi law ywak.
Ewi tat udi duto man Moab
Mano kaka Moab loko ngʼeye kopondo nikech wichkuot!
gima bwogo ji duto man bute."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
E odiechiengno chunje mag jolwenj Moab
nochal gi chuny dhako mamuoch kayo.
nikech ne otamore winjo Jehova Nyasaye.
nikech masira nolwar e bur matut,
ngʼatno manotem kawuok ei bur matut,
kuom Moab e higa mar kum,"
joma noringo odongʼ ka ok nyal,
kendo ligek mach osewuok e dier Sihon;
Mano kaka inine malit, yaye Moab!
Ma e giko mar ngʼadone Moab bura.
